#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long comb(int n, int c) {
    if (c > n) return 0;
    if (c == n) return 1;
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < c; ++i) ans *= (n - i);
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; ++i) ans /= i;
    return ans;
}

double cal(int m, int n) {
    long long ttl = comb(n, 3);
    double ans = 0.0;
    ans += 1.0 * comb(m, 3);
    ans += 1.0 * comb(m, 2) * comb(n - m, 1);
    ans += 0.5 * comb(m, 1) * comb(n - m, 2);
    return ans / ttl;
}

void solve() {
    int n;
    double p;
    cin >> n >> p;
    int l = 0, r = n - 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        double x = cal(m, n);
        if (x >= p) r = m;
        else l = m + 1;
    }
    cout << l << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
